temporal_state_chain.observed: Cheryl is stressed and overwhelmed by stacks of paperwork and planning for the new community outreach project; Cheryl accepts Maria's offer to help.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria feels relieved that Cheryl valued her honesty and support; Maria proposes co-leading the project, and Cheryl enthusiastically agrees, calling them a great team.

temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria and Cheryl can effectively co-lead the project; they make a great team and can support each other.

temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Maria's belief is confirmed and strengthened—their partnership has produced successful collaboration and Cheryl wants to continue.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Their partnership is strong and synergistic, and future collaboration is desirable and promising.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Team up with Cheryl for more projects in the future and continue their fruitful collaboration.
